reference_sql:
WITH promo AS (
  -- one row: promotion P-2025-03 with its dates and its number of weeks
  SELECT promo_id, start_date, end_date,
         date_diff('week', date_trunc('week', start_date), date_trunc('week', end_date)) + 1 AS n_weeks
  FROM promotions
  WHERE promo_code = 'P-2025-03'
),
category_products AS (
  -- one row per product in a category that holds a product of the promotion
  SELECT pr.product_id, pr.category_id,
         CASE WHEN EXISTS (
           SELECT 1
           FROM promotion_products AS pp
           JOIN promo AS p ON p.promo_id = pp.promo_id
           WHERE pp.product_id = pr.product_id
         ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_promoted
  FROM products AS pr
  WHERE pr.category_id IN (
    SELECT pr2.category_id
    FROM promotion_products AS pp2
    JOIN promo AS p2 ON p2.promo_id = pp2.promo_id
    JOIN products AS pr2 ON pr2.product_id = pp2.product_id
  )
),
product_changes AS (
  -- one row per product of those categories, with its change in units
  SELECT cp.category_id, cp.product_id, cp.is_promoted,
         (AVG(CASE WHEN w.week_start BETWEEN p.start_date AND p.end_date THEN w.units END)
          - AVG(CASE WHEN w.week_start >= p.start_date - INTERVAL 28 DAY
                      AND w.week_start < p.start_date THEN w.units END)) * p.n_weeks AS change_units
  FROM category_products AS cp
  JOIN weekly_units AS w ON w.product_id = cp.product_id
  CROSS JOIN promo AS p
  GROUP BY cp.category_id, cp.product_id, cp.is_promoted, p.n_weeks
)
SELECT pc.category_id, c.category_name,
       SUM(CASE WHEN pc.is_promoted = 1 THEN pc.change_units ELSE 0 END) AS promoted_incremental_units,
       SUM(CASE WHEN pc.is_promoted = 0 THEN -pc.change_units ELSE 0 END) AS cannibalised_units,
       SUM(pc.change_units) AS net_incremental_units,
       ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN pc.is_promoted = 0 THEN -pc.change_units ELSE 0 END)
             / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN pc.is_promoted = 1 THEN pc.change_units ELSE 0 END), 0), 1) AS cannibalisation_rate_pct
FROM product_changes AS pc
JOIN categories AS c ON c.category_id = pc.category_id
GROUP BY pc.category_id, c.category_name
ORDER BY pc.category_id

         CASE WHEN m.product_id IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS is_promoted
  FROM products AS pr
  LEFT JOIN promoted AS m ON m.product_id = pr.product_id
  WHERE pr.category_id IN (
    SELECT pr2.category_id
    FROM products AS pr2
    JOIN promoted AS m2 ON m2.product_id = pr2.product_id
  )
),
product_changes AS (
  -- one row per product of those categories, with its change in units
  SELECT cp.category_id, cp.is_promoted,
         SUM(CASE WHEN w.week_start >= p.start_date THEN w.units ELSE 0 END)
           - SUM(CASE WHEN w.week_start < p.start_date THEN w.units ELSE 0 END) / 4.0 * p.n_weeks AS change_units
  FROM category_products AS cp
  JOIN weekly_units AS w ON w.product_id = cp.product_id
  JOIN promo AS p ON w.week_start BETWEEN p.start_date - INTERVAL 28 DAY AND p.end_date
  GROUP BY cp.category_id, cp.product_id, cp.is_promoted, p.n_weeks
)
SELECT pc.category_id, c.category_name,
       SUM(pc.change_units * pc.is_promoted) AS promoted_incremental_units,
       SUM(-pc.change_units * (1 - pc.is_promoted)) AS cannibalised_units,
       SUM(pc.change_units) AS net_incremental_units,
       ROUND(100.0 * SUM(-pc.change_units * (1 - pc.is_promoted))
             / NULLIF(SUM(pc.change_units * pc.is_promoted), 0), 1) AS cannibalisation_rate_pct
FROM product_changes AS pc
JOIN categories AS c ON c.category_id = pc.category_id
GROUP BY pc.category_id, c.category_name
ORDER BY pc.category_id

SELECT t.category_id, c.category_name,
       SUM(CASE WHEN t.is_promoted = 1 THEN t.change_units ELSE 0 END) AS promoted_incremental_units,
       SUM(CASE WHEN t.is_promoted = 0 THEN -t.change_units ELSE 0 END) AS cannibalised_units,
       SUM(t.change_units) AS net_incremental_units,
       ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN t.is_promoted = 0 THEN -t.change_units ELSE 0 END)
             / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN t.is_promoted = 1 THEN t.change_units ELSE 0 END), 0), 1) AS cannibalisation_rate_pct
FROM (
  -- one row per product in a category that holds a product of the promotion
  SELECT pr.category_id, pr.product_id,
         CASE WHEN pr.product_id IN (
           SELECT pp.product_id
           FROM promotion_products AS pp
           JOIN promotions AS p2 ON p2.promo_id = pp.promo_id
           WHERE p2.promo_code = 'P-2025-03'
         ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_promoted,
         (AVG(CASE WHEN w.week_start >= p.start_date THEN w.units END)
          - AVG(CASE WHEN w.week_start < p.start_date THEN w.units END))
         * (date_diff('week', date_trunc('week', p.start_date), date_trunc('week', p.end_date)) + 1) AS change_units
  FROM promotions AS p
  JOIN weekly_units AS w ON w.week_start BETWEEN p.start_date - INTERVAL 28 DAY AND p.end_date
  JOIN products AS pr ON pr.product_id = w.product_id
  WHERE p.promo_code = 'P-2025-03'
    AND pr.category_id IN (
      SELECT pr3.category_id
      FROM promotion_products AS pp3
      JOIN promotions AS p3 ON p3.promo_id = pp3.promo_id
      JOIN products AS pr3 ON pr3.product_id = pp3.product_id
      WHERE p3.promo_code = 'P-2025-03'
    )
  GROUP BY pr.category_id, pr.product_id, p.start_date, p.end_date
) AS t
JOIN categories AS c ON c.category_id = t.category_id
GROUP BY t.category_id, c.category_name
ORDER BY t.category_id

solver.query:
WITH pr AS (SELECT promo_id, CAST(start_date AS DATE) AS s, CAST(end_date AS DATE) AS e FROM promotions WHERE promo_code = 'P-2025-03'),
promoted AS (SELECT x.product_id FROM promotion_products x JOIN pr ON pr.promo_id = x.promo_id),
cats AS (SELECT DISTINCT p.category_id FROM products p JOIN promoted d ON d.product_id = p.product_id),
prod AS (SELECT p.product_id, p.category_id, (p.product_id IN (SELECT product_id FROM promoted)) AS is_promoted FROM products p WHERE p.category_id IN (SELECT category_id FROM cats)),
chg AS (SELECT prod.product_id, prod.category_id, prod.is_promoted,
  (AVG(CASE WHEN CAST(w.week_start AS DATE) BETWEEN pr.s AND pr.e THEN w.units END) - SUM(CASE WHEN CAST(w.week_start AS DATE) >= pr.s - 28 AND CAST(w.week_start AS DATE) < pr.s THEN w.units END) / 4.0)
   * COUNT(CASE WHEN CAST(w.week_start AS DATE) BETWEEN pr.s AND pr.e THEN 1 END) AS change
 FROM prod CROSS JOIN pr JOIN weekly_units w ON w.product_id = prod.product_id GROUP BY prod.product_id, prod.category_id, prod.is_promoted)
, cs AS (SELECT category_id, SUM(CASE WHEN is_promoted THEN change ELSE 0 END) AS promoted_incremental_units, SUM(CASE WHEN is_promoted THEN 0 ELSE -change END) AS cannibalised_units FROM chg GROUP BY category_id)
SELECT c.category_id, c.category_name, cs.promoted_incremental_units, cs.cannibalised_units,
 cs.promoted_incremental_units - cs.cannibalised_units AS net_incremental_units,
 ROUND(100 * cs.cannibalised_units / NULLIF(cs.promoted_incremental_units, 0), 1) AS cannibalisation_rate_pct
FROM cs JOIN categories c ON c.category_id = cs.category_id ORDER BY c.category_id
